      I use AI to process your questions and generate answers, and our interaction is monitored and recorded. If you do not want to be monitored or recorded, please do not interact with me.       Essential power in a focused design

      Alienware 16 Aurora delivers an immersive gaming-first experience in a sleek, focused design. Get the performance you need, anywhere – powered by Intel® Core™ processors (Series 2) and laptop GPUs ranging from NVIDIA GeForce RTX™ 4050 up to 5070.
      Announcing slider with 4 slides

      Intentional design

      A comfortable, efficient design that doesn't need a thermal shelf, increasing mobility without sacrificing performance.

      Optimized power

      Play demanding games with up to 115W Total Performance Power (TPP)[1].

      Innovative cooling

      A newly designed Cryo-Chamber structure focuses airflow to the core components, where it matters most.

      Brilliant display

      Go deeper into games with a 16” WQXGA 120Hz display with 300 nits brightness.

      Comfort focused design

      Intentionally designed for comfortable, everyday use. Alienware 16 Aurora’s streamlined design offers advanced thermal support without the need for a rear thermal shelf. The laptop’s smaller profile makes it an easy fit into bags and backpacks for on-the-go performance.

      Easy to carry. Hard to put down.
      • Easy to carry. Hard to put down.
      • Alienware 16 Aurora is designed with premium materials, such as an anodized aluminum lid featuring an iridescent Alienware logo and magnesium alloy interior frame.
      • Soft, smooth contours make the laptop more comfortable to hold, complimented by a stunning new colorway Interstellar Indigo with a satin finish.
      • Opening and closing your laptop lid just got easier thanks to an angled front edge. Plus, a gently pillowed palm rest ensures comfort during any gaming session.

      Balanced power

      The perfect balance of performance and portability in a stunning chassis. Ready to run your favorite games seamlessly with up to 115W Total Performance Power[2].
      Announcing slider with 3 slides

      Up to 115W

      Total Performance Power[3] is the combined maximum of TGP and TDP, enhancing overall performance across all you do.

      Up to 85W

      Total Graphics Power means higher GPU performance with more realistic gameplay[4].

      Up to 45W

      CPU Thermal Design Power means full power devoted towards processing tasks in real-time.

      Ready for tomorrow

      With ample storage and memory, Aurora is built to game and multitask today and beyond. This laptop features two upgradeable PCIe Gen 4 SSD slots[5] and two user-upgradeable DDR5 SO-DIMM memory slots.

      Game changing graphics

      The 16 Aurora is available with NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 4050, or step into the future of gaming and creation with NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 50 Series Laptop GPUs, powered by NVIDIA Blackwell and AI. Designed to push boundaries, RTX 50 Series with NVIDIA Max-Q delivers optimized battery life and performance and jaw-dropping graphics fidelity—perfect for those who demand the extraordinary on the go.
      Announcing slider with 5 slides

      Ray tracing redefined

      Experience cinematic realism with full ray tracing and breakthrough neural rendering technologies. From stunning light reflections to intricate shadows, your in-game world looks better than ever.

      AI-boosted gameplay

      Unleash next-level performance and image quality with DLSS 4. Achieve ultra-smooth frame rates with Multi Frame Generation and enhanced Ray Reconstruction.

      Competitive advantage

      Compete faster with NVIDIA® Reflex 2 technology featuring Frame Warp, which further reduces latency based on the game’s latest mouse input.

      Unparalleled video playback

      The RTX 50 Series redefines how you enjoy your favorite movies, shows and videos. With advanced AI-powered upscaling and buttery-smooth playback, immerse yourself in vibrant colors, stunning clarity and flawless streaming.

      Immersive entertainment

      Rethink how you stream, chat or create content with NVIDIA Broadcast’s advanced AI enhancements. Clear your audio, upgrade your video, and craft your AI-powered home studio effortlessly.

      Quiet and cool

      Built to last

      Efficient thermal design protects internal components and extends the life of the system.

      Advanced thermals for extended play

      Dual fans

      Two fans with ultra-thin blades pull cool air in from the top and bottom; exhaust hot air out 4 vents to help enable higher performance.

      Copper heat pipes
